SELECT invite_key AS inviteKey, workspace_id AS workspaceId, inviter_id AS inviterId, accepted_member_id AS acceptedMemberId, email, name, status, TO_CHAR(expires, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS expires, TO_CHAR(accepted, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS accepted, TO_CHAR(created, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS created, invite_status AS inviteStatus FROM workspace_invites WHERE invite_key = #{inviteKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO workspace_members wm USING ( SELECT #{workspaceId} AS workspace_id, #{memberId} AS member_id FROM dual) src ON (wm.workspace_id = src.workspace_id AND wm.member_id = src.member_id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET wm.status = 0, wm.role = #{role}, wm.joined = SYSDATE, wm."LEFT" = NULL WHERE wm.status = 1 WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (workspace_member_id, workspace_id, member_id, status, joined, role) VALUES (seq_workspace_members.NEXTVAL, src.workspace_id, src.member_id, 0, SYSDATE, #{role})
